XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Engine malfunction indicator light comes on, with properly running vehicle
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INJECTION | ELECTRONICS | P1320 | P0380 | P1612 | P0560 | FUSE | BROKEN | COMPARTMENT | ENGINE | SIDE | DRIVER | START | PART | IGNITION | FAILURE | IGNITION | FAILURE | START-UP | FUNCTION | OPERATION | START | TURNING | OFF |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: Fuse F17 (Injection control unit protection)

  • Fault: Engine failed to start following a sudden stop whilst driving

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis:
  • P1320 (Phase and engine speed signal consistency - Fault)
  • P0380 (Pre-heater 1 timing control - Malfunction)
  • P1612 (Fuel filter heater relay)
  • P0560 (Fuel system / battery - Incorrect voltage)
  • Cause: Fuse F17 (Injection control unit protection)

• Action: Check the condition of fuse F17 (Injection control unit protection) and replace it if necessary

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The component in question is located in the fuse box, situated in the engine compartment on the driver’s side, near the radiator.
